Added 50 A, rates $43-48 (2025-dated rate page) + $2.50/night online fee, 3-night holiday minimum, 2026 season May 8-Oct 18, dump/store/internet. Good Sam false (directory-derived) left alone. flags: Long-stay test, for a human: the park offers 'daily, weekly, monthly, and seasonal rates' and now hosts rallies; nightly stays are bookable online with no application, but the site gives no count of seasonal sites, so the 1-in-10 nightly test cannot be checked from its pages.
Rate page is headed with the 2025 season; no 2026 rate table is posted. With the $2.50/night online fee the base is $45.50, under US$50.
